user_question: Assign each Centre County hospital to the census tract that contains it and return the tract identifier with each hospital.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts.

workflow_plan.goal: Assign each Centre County hospital to the census tract that contains it and return the tract identifier with each hospital.

workflow_steps.title: Reproject hospitals to tract CRS
workflow_steps.purpose: Create a hospital point layer in the same CRS as the census tracts.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject the hospital point dataset from EPSG:4326 to EPSG:26918 without changing its attributes or analytical meaning.

workflow_steps.title: Assign hospitals to containing census tracts
workflow_steps.purpose: Spatially join each Centre County hospital point to the census tract that contains it and return the tract identifier with the hospital attributes.
workflow_steps.instructions: Perform a spatial join between the reprojected hospital points and the census tract polygons. Retain each hospital record and append the containing tract identifier from the GEOID field.

requirements.scope: The hospital point and census tract polygon inputs to the spatial join must use the same coordinate reference system.
